newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Telstra sale could yield A$15 bln - Harradine.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Telstra sale could yield A$15 bln - Harradine.

text.p: Key Australian Independent senator Brian Harradine said on Thursday he had been advised that one-third of telecoms carrier Telstra Corp could be sold for a price of up to A$15.0 billion.
This compared with the A$8.0 billion suggested by the government, Harradine told parliament.
"An assessment was done by one of my staff, which indicates that in fact a third sale could well yield A$15.0 billion," he said.

Harradine and fellow Independent Mal Colston are crucial to the passing of the Telstra sale legislation as they are the only possible sources of the two extra votes that the government needs to pass any legislation in the upper house Senate.
All other non-government parties are opposed to the sale. -- Canberra Bureau 61-6 273-2730
